Direction check: the H1-2026 interim report converts the RMB19.16c interim dividend to HKD22.07c at RMB1.00:HKD1.1521 (Aug-2026 average), and the H1 buyback cost HKD206.8m against RMB188m in the equity statement -- both HKD > RMB, so multiplying CNY per-share values by ~1.17 is the right direction. No dual listing exists for a price parity check (HKEX-only). Statements are RMB'million; the worksheet's currency hint was wrong.

inputs.share_count_basis: ~8,620m shares in issue at 25-Aug-2026 per the interim-dividend note (H1-2026 report); no options/convertibles so basic = diluted. Down from 8,658.8m after the 2026 buyback (29.0m bought in H1, HKD206.8m). Held FLAT: SBC is zero, and further buybacks are funded from the net cash already in the bridge, so they are value-neutral at fair value.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency: China 10y CGB ~1.85% + beta ~0.9 x CNY ERP ~7.25% = ~8.4%, rounded 8.5%. Company is net cash so WACC = cost of equity. Same rate across scenarios -- policy/gas-price risk is carried in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: FY2025 lease cash = principal 529 + interest 14 = 543 (FY25 cash-flow statement, financing) = 0.28% of revenue, deducted via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (635 at 30-Jun-2026: 285 current + 350 non-current) EXCLUDED from total_debt, which is borrowings only (7,033 short + 13,637 long = 20,670). da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (~2.45% vs reported 2.72%; ROU depreciation taken as ~equal to lease principal) so the lease is not charged twice in cash-tax EBIT. Treatment (A) was rejected: liabilities of only ~635 against ~543/yr of payments means short-dated leases that renew continually, so debt-only treatment would understate the ongoing cost.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI charged once, in the flows: cash_tax_rate_path is a COMBINED cash-tax + NCI leakage rate. Cash tax ~25% of PBT (FY25 tax paid 2,809 / PBT 11,661 = 24.1%) and NCI took 36.9% of FY25 profit (3,120 of 8,466), 34.5% in H1-2026 -> 1-(0.75 x 0.65) = ~51%; path starts at 52%. Calibration: FY25 EBIT 11,616 x (1-0.52) = 5,576 vs attributable profit 5,346 (5,923 core ex impairments) -- ties within non-operating noise. NCI book equity (24,212) is NOT deducted in the bridge. Capex and D&A pass through at 100%, overcharging the parent ~RMB0.2bn/yr of NCI's share of net reinvestment (conservative). Because most cash sits in part-owned subsidiaries (corporate-level assets only 15,111 of 48,068 cash), the NCI share of subsidiary-level net cash is deducted in the equity_bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF with non-US adaptations (CNY filer / HKD quote, NCI leakage, leases as debt, SBC-zero, cyclical risk charged once in the flows). Routed per dcf-methods SKILL.md: Kunlun is a regulated-ish operating company (city-gas distribution ~83% of revenue, LNG terminals/processing, LPG, small E&P), not a bank/REIT/holdco. First valuation of this ticker. EBITDA is the company's own reported figure (PBT + interest expense + DD&A - interest income) and INCLUDES share of associate/JV profits (1,237 in FY25) and 'other gains' (1,147) -- associates/JVs are therefore NOT added to the bridge. Interest income is already outside EBITDA and is stripped from last_fcf; the cash is in the bridge. Series break: FY2018-19 include the Beijing pipeline business sold in 2021; FY2020+ are continuing operations; FY2021 net income (23,016) includes a 17,875 discontinued disposal gain and a 20,320 special dividend, so FY2021 is excluded as a growth base. Buybacks: RMB188m in H1-2026 (first since at least FY2018) under a ~10%-of-capital mandate; flat count is now being funded by a repurchaser. Timing: balance sheet is 30-Jun-2026 but Y1 is full FY2026, so the H1-2026 attributable owner FCF already sitting in June cash is backed out in the bridge. FCF cross-check FY2025 (attributable, unlevered): OCF 12,430 - capex 5,882 + JV/associate dividends 986 + PPE disposals 450 - lease cash 543 - NCI dividends net of NCI contributions 2,266 - associate capital contributions 305 = ~4,870, after a 1,212 working-capital outflow; model Y1 owner FCF should sit near this.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (4.2-4.8%) diverges >30% from 5yr revenue CAGR (12.2%) and from 5yr EPS CAGR (8.4%). Revenue's 5yr figure is inflated by the 2021-22 gas-price spike and low-margin LNG/LPG trading volume; the 3yr revenue CAGR (4.1%) agrees with equity. EPS 3yr is ~flat (0.6038 -> 0.6174).
historical_growth.notes: All CAGRs computed on the FY2020+ continuing-operations series (the FY2018-19 rows include the divested pipeline business). FY2021 is never used as an endpoint: net income 23,016 includes the 17,875 disposal gain and equity was depleted by the 20,320 special dividend. EPS 5yr uses FY2020 continuing EPS (3,580 / 8,658.8 = 0.413), not the reported 0.700 that includes discontinued profit. Owner FCF = reported FCF - interest income (SBC = 0); the owner-FCF CAGRs are negative because FY2020-22 OCF carried working-capital releases and net cash (and interest income) rose sharply after the 2021 disposal. All figures RMB millions.

base.narrative: Gas volumes track China's ~5%/yr consumption plan only partly (H1-26 national demand -2.4%); revenue +3% in FY26 (H1 +2.6%) then 3.5-4% as LNG terminals/bunkering scale, fading to 2.5%. EBITDA margin 8.8% in FY26 (H1-26 ~9.5% on the reported definition, H2 seasonally weaker and carries impairments), edging to 9.1% as residential pass-through (72%) and higher-margin LNG mix offset trading dilution. D&A 2.75%, capex 3.0% (FY22-25 range 2.9-3.3%). Combined cash-tax + NCI leakage 52% easing to 51% as the attributable share keeps rising.
base.cash_tax_rate_path_note: Combined cash tax (~25%) and NCI leakage (~35% of after-tax profit); see inputs.nci_treatment
base.wc_capture_pct_note: Zero: city-gas prepayments/contract liabilities roughly offset receivables and inventory; no reliable growth-linked pattern in FY20-25
base.da_pct_path_note: D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (reported FY25 DD&A 2.72% of revenue less ~0.27% ROU)

bull.narrative: LNG becomes the 'second profit pole' (sales >10 bcm, H1-26 +42.6%), consumption returns to the ~5% 15th-FYP trend, and pass-through reform completes, lifting margin back toward the FY23 ~10% level; continued buy-ins of minorities raise the attributable share.
bull.da_pct_path_note: D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (reported FY25 DD&A 2.72% of revenue less ~0.27% ROU)

bear.narrative: City-gas demand stays weak with high imported-gas costs and delayed local-government pass-through; recurring impairments from loss-making-subsidiary clean-up keep margin sliding to 7.8% (FY25 8.7%); electrification caps long-run volume growth; receivables from local governments absorb cash.
bear.da_pct_path_note: D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (reported FY25 DD&A 2.72% of revenue less ~0.27% ROU)

scenario_narratives.base: Kunlun compounds as a low-growth, net-cash city-gas utility: revenue ~3-4% on volume plus LNG mix, EBITDA margin stable at ~9% (between FY25's impairment-hit 8.7% and FY23's 10.0%), capex roughly matching D&A, and ~35% of profit leaking to minorities in part-owned city-gas and LNG subsidiaries. The 50%-minimum payout and ~10% buyback mandate return cash but do not change the flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: The axes are LNG and pricing policy: LNG terminals, plants and offshore bunkering keep scaling at double digits and carry segment margins far above gas retail; residential price pass-through reaches full linkage; China gas demand reverts to the ~5%/yr plan. Margin rebuilds to ~9.9% and minority buy-ins lift the attributable share.
scenario_narratives.bear: The axes are tariff policy and demand: high import costs with lagged pass-through squeeze distribution margins, industrial gas demand stays soft (H1-26 national consumption -2.4%), impairments from loss-making subsidiaries recur, and electrification bends the long-run curve. Revenue grows ~1.5%, margin falls to 7.8%, and working capital absorbs cash.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 20% (above the 15% default) for single-regulator dependence on China gas tariff policy and two consecutive years of falling core profit. Base 55%: a net-cash SOE utility with a stated payout floor has a narrow outcome distribution. Bull 25% (below 35%) because it needs LNG scaling, pricing reform and demand recovery to all go right.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Net-cash, CNPC-controlled city-gas and LNG operator valued on attributable owner FCF in CNY at a CNY cost of capital, converted to HKD at the spot rate. The two judgment calls that matter most are the ~35% minority leakage (charged once, in the flows) and how much of the consolidated cash pile actually belongs to Kunlun shareholders.
key_risks_to_valuation: China gas tariff / pass-through policy (single-regulator dependency)
NCI leakage rate: each 1pp of combined leakage is ~2% of value
Cash attribution: ~two-thirds of the cash sits in part-owned subsidiaries; the NCI-share deduction is estimated from the segment note
CNY/HKD rate moves the HKD value one-for-one; refresh_price.py does not refresh fx_rate
Recurring impairments from loss-making-subsidiary governance (565 FY24, 732 FY25) are inside the EBITDA margin anchor
